scenario.topic: Choose the headline genre mix for a student music festival

options.name: Rock and Indie Focus
options.upside: Attracts a dedicated fanbase familiar with local bands.
options.concern: May limit appeal to fans of other genres.

options.name: Mixed Pop and Electronic
options.upside: Broad appeal with energetic performances and dance-friendly sets.
options.concern: Higher production needs increase setup time and costs.

options.name: Hip-Hop and R&B Blend
options.upside: Engages a younger demographic with trending artists.
options.concern: Sound requirements may be challenging for an outdoor venue.

options.name: Eclectic Mix Across Genres
options.upside: Offers variety to satisfy diverse musical tastes.
options.concern: Complex scheduling and higher costs due to multiple genre setups.

shared_context: A student music festival is selecting a headline genre mix to appeal to a diverse audience of 7 decision-makers. Each option balances genre variety, expected attendance, and logistical complexity for a one-day outdoor event.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a university music club president passionate about local rock and indie scenes.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the festival highlights local talent and fosters a strong community vibe.

A.reason_for: Attracts a dedicated fanbase familiar with local bands, aligning with my goal to support local music.

B.reason_for: Broad appeal could increase attendance and energy.
B.reason_against: High logistical complexity and less focus on local rock/indie.

C.reason_for: Engages younger demographics, which is good for festival growth.
C.reason_against: Sound requirements might complicate outdoor setup.

D.reason_for: Variety satisfies diverse tastes, potentially increasing attendance.
D.reason_against: Very high logistical complexity and cost.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a student event coordinator focused on maximizing attendance and smooth operations.
personas.private_goal: Drive the largest possible crowd while keeping production manageable.

A.reason_for: Dedicated fanbase is good but limited in size.
A.reason_against: May limit appeal and expected attendance is lower.

B.reason_for: Highest expected attendance with broad appeal and energetic performances.

C.reason_for: Good demographic engagement and medium complexity.
C.reason_against: Sound challenges outdoors could cause issues.

D.reason_for: Variety could attract a larger crowd.
D.reason_against: Very high logistical complexity and cost.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a music journalist who values authentic and focused music experiences.
personas.private_goal: Promote genres with strong artistic identity and loyal audiences.

A.reason_for: Rock and Indie focus offers authentic, loyal fan engagement.

B.reason_for: Broad appeal but feels less authentic and more commercial.
B.reason_against: High logistical complexity and less focus on core genres.

C.reason_for: Hip-Hop and R&B are culturally relevant and engaging.
C.reason_against: Sound challenges outdoors could affect quality.

D.reason_for: Variety is interesting but may dilute focus.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a technical stage manager experienced in outdoor event logistics.
personas.private_goal: Minimize technical risks and ensure smooth sound and stage transitions.

A.reason_for: Medium logistical complexity and fewer headliners ease management.
A.reason_against: Limited genre variety may reduce audience size.

B.reason_for: Broad appeal but high production needs increase setup time.
B.reason_against: Higher risk of delays and costs.

C.reason_for: Medium complexity with a focused genre blend I can manage well.

D.reason_for: Variety is good but very high complexity is risky.
D.reason_against: Complex scheduling and costs increase failure points.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a student marketing lead aiming to attract a young, trendy crowd.
personas.private_goal: Boost festival buzz with popular and current music styles.

A.reason_for: Dedicated fanbase but less trendy for younger audiences.

B.reason_for: Broad appeal and energetic performances attract youth.
B.reason_against: High production costs but worth the buzz.

C.reason_for: Hip-Hop and R&B are trending and engage young demographics well.

D.reason_against: Very high logistical complexity and costs.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a finance student focused on cost efficiency and risk reduction.
personas.private_goal: Keep festival costs reasonable while maintaining good attendance.

A.reason_for: Medium complexity and decent attendance with loyal fans.

B.reason_for: Highest attendance but high costs and complexity.
B.reason_against: Production needs increase risk and expenses.

C.reason_for: Medium complexity with good attendance and demographic appeal.

D.reason_for: Variety is good but very high costs and complexity are risky.

personas.name: Tess
personas.background: Tess is a pragmatic student leader who values straightforward decisions and efficiency.
personas.private_goal: Choose a headline mix that maximizes attendance with minimal fuss.

A.reason_for: Good fanbase but limited appeal and attendance.

B.reason_for: Highest expected attendance and broad appeal.

C.reason_for: Good demographic but sound challenges outdoors.
C.reason_against: Medium complexity but less attendance than B.
